links.outcome: Response accuracy of generative chatbots versus retrieval-based chatbot on same patient questions, graded by specialists
links.effect: Median scores 6 (1) for ChatGPT-4 and ChatGPT-3.5 vs 4.5 (2) Google Bard and 2 (1) OcularBERT; 'Good' ratings 83.3%, 86.7%, 50%, 10%.
links.quote: Based on the consensus approach, 83.3% of ChatGPT-4's responses and 86.7% of ChatGPT-3.5's were rated as 'Good', surpassing Google Bard (50%) and OcularBERT (10%) (all p ≤1.4×10<sup>-2</sup>).

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the response quality and accuracy of generative LLM chatbots versus a retrieval-based model on simulated patient questions about retinal diseases without evaluating a specific deployment safeguard.
